reason: Article 5(1)(b) of the DORA Delegated Regulation establishes the requirement for an intermediate report to be submitted within 72 hours of the initial notification. This directly supports the control objective of submitting the report within the specified timeframe.
applicability_note: This mapping is specific to the DORA framework and applies to all entities within its scope, including Critical ICT Third-Party Service Providers (CIRTSPs) and Financial Market Infrastructures (FMIs).
challenge_comment: The mapping is precise and directly addresses the control statement. No further analysis is required as the provision is clear and the requirement is explicitly stated.
